reviews.review: it's fun it's cheap it's replayable. it's worth the money.

I haven't played the original Risk of Rain, but I have played Risk of Rain 2.

The game is engaging and fun, with lots of challenges and content to look forward to. I was expecting the change from 3D to side-view 2D to feel like a downngrade, but that's not the case. It just requires some adjusting to the different aiming and movement mechanics. 

The music is also great, as expected 👌

If you enjoyed the original Risk of Rain, chances are you'll like Risk of Rain Returns-- to me it's a direct upgrade in every department. There are options to remove additions, ie only original stages/enemies, original teleporter rules, etc. Lovely key art in the logs for enemies and survivors!
The alternate skills are a great addition. Fun to mix stuff up! I was skeptical about the Providence trials but they were actually pretty nice-- they cared. There's also plenty of secrets (usually no-collision walls) to find.

They start you out zoomed in 2x which I think doesn't show enough-- but 1x makes everything very small. Anything in between feels weird too. I think it's just a tiny game, honestly. 

The controls on gamepad are a little weird-- but you can rebind them.

I'm not sure if RIsk of Rain 2 fans will enjoy or not-- there is a lot less focus on creating builds for your character (via scrap/print), and the overall item pool skews to a different meta/endgame. 2D is a massive difference for traversal, enemies, and attacks in general-- it plays quite different. I think they should give it a shot, keeping in mind that Risk of Rain 2 is more like a spin-off to the original than a successor.

Little cons:
If you go high enough speeds, you can clip through walls and get stuck locked outside the play area. Lost a few good runs to this, not being able to reach the same speed to get out.
There are some abilities in the game that fire much, much faster if you mash the fire button, but the game doesn't tell you that for most (Bandit does tell you iirc)-- there IS an option to make it full auto in accessibility which is amazing (I love my fingers and my controller!) but it doesn't function for some abilities, ie Chef's alternate primary and Artificer's primary.

I have tons of problem with this game but if I have to pick one, I'd say finding teleporter is the most annoying problem of this game. The red particles that indicate teleporter is nearby should be more noticeable. They should start popping up from further distance because the map is so freaking large for no reason. And also, Devs just gave up on this game
